aiSearch.helpText: AI Search requires the violet-search server to be running separately. You need to set up and run the violet-search service for this feature to work.

imageCache.heading: Image Cache
imageCache.enableDesc: Cache viewed images locally for instant loading
imageCache.helpText: Uses the browser's IndexedDB to store viewed images locally. Cached images load instantly without network requests. Cache is best-effort — if storage fails, images are loaded normally from the server.

exhentaiCookie.heading: ExHentai Cookie
exhentaiCookie.description: Used to load galleries from ExHentai when Hitomi metadata is unavailable. Public E-Hentai galleries do not require a cookie.
exhentaiCookie.requiredValues: ipb_member_id, ipb_pass_hash, and igneous are all required.
exhentaiCookie.saved: Cookie saved. It will be used for the next request.
exhentaiCookie.removed: The cookie stored by the web settings was removed.
exhentaiCookie.error: Could not complete the request. Check the cookie format and server log.
exhentaiCookie.environmentHint: A .env cookie is active. Edit .env on the Pi and recreate the web container to remove it.
exhentaiCookie.securityNote: A cookie is login information. Do not expose this server to the public internet. The stored value is never returned to the page or API.

bookmarkSync.heading: App/web record sync
bookmarkSync.description: Sync article bookmarks, reading progress and completed-download records. Folders, artist bookmarks and files stay on each device. New bookmarks enter the default folder.
bookmarkSync.saved: Settings saved. An empty token disables synchronization.
bookmarkSync.notReady: Sync is disabled or another sync is running.
bookmarkSync.error: Sync failed. Check the token and connect to the WalnutPi network; your local bookmarks are retained.
